title: Bitter Sausage Toad in the Hole
description: A classic British dish with sausages cooked in a bitter beer batter, served in a toad in the hole style.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the bitter beer, flour, eggs, and milk.
Add salt and pepper to the batter and mix well.
In a separate pan, cook the sausages over medium heat until browned.
Transfer the sausages to a baking dish and pour the batter over them.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the batter is golden brown and the sausages are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Traditional British accompaniments include roasted vegetables and mashed potatoes.
